measure.name: transmittance_info
measure.description: Computes, without simulating, the thermal transmittance (U-value) of the opaque constructions and glazing applied in the model and opens a report in the web browser. Use it with 'Apply Measure Now' (Components & Measures menu). It does not modify the model.
measure.modeler_description: Goes through Surfaces and SubSurfaces and takes their effective construction (including those from Default Construction Sets). Opaque: U = 1/(Rsi + Σe/λ + Rse) with Rsi/Rse from EN ISO 6946 / CTE DA DB-HE/1 according to the tilt (horizontal flow if 60° ≤ tilt ≤ 120°) and the boundary condition (ground: Rse = 0, ground not included; partitions: Rsi on both sides); also the U-value with the ASHRAE films of the EnergyPlus Envelope Summary. F/C-factor: equivalent U = F·P/A and C. Glazing: SimpleGlazing with its own values; layered glazing with the ISO 15099 centre-of-glass U-value under NFRC winter conditions (21/−18 °C, hc,out = 26 W/m²K, ISO 15099 inside convection with a 1 m height, gases and mixtures with the EnergyPlus coefficients) and the EN 673 Ug. Net areas × zone multiplier; paired partitions are counted once. The HTML report is saved in the chosen folder (or in the system temporary folder) and opened with the default web browser.

argument.name: open_browser
argument.display_name: Open the report in the web browser when finished

argument.name: output_folder
argument.display_name: Folder where the report is saved (empty = system temporary folder)
argument.description: For example C:\Users\name\Documents. The report path is shown in the measure messages.

argument.name: include_interior
argument.display_name: Include interior partitions, doors and windows
